component.name: FastFlowLM Backend
component.summary: AMD Ryzen AI NPU inference backend for Lemonade

description.p: This extension adds the FastFlowLM inference backend to Lemonade. Once installed, Lemonade can select FastFlowLM as one of its backends to serve large language models directly on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs.

FastFlowLM is an NPU-optimized runtime that delivers fast, efficient language model inference on tile-structured neural processing units. It provides instant token streaming and support for context windows up to 256k tokens, with multiple AI modalities including reasoning models, vision, audio, and embeddings.
